'''Mug'garat''' was a [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who worked for [[Rogun Matt'rik]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], Mug'garat was sent by Rogun to deal with the smuggler later known as [[Voidhound]] who believed that he was helping the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]]. After the [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']] was destroyed in orbit above [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Mug'garat corned [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bevera Dodonna]] in order to lure Ace into a trap. Hoping that Rogun would be happy that he beat Ace, he and two of his [[Ssorokk]]s engaged the smuggler, but were all defeated and killed.
